title: 021 极乐真人022 定数变数
content_zh:
：管明晦以为李静虚神通广大，自己杀了陆敏，他很快就会找上门来，做好了必死的决心。
然而，这时候的李静虚还在凝炼先天五行化身。
极乐真人李静虚，入道比长眉真人稍晚。
大约在东晋年间，长眉真人受师弟邓隐拖累，兵解转世。
座下十二弟子跟着兵解，等着恩师再来度化。
李静虚在长眉真人二次入道之前得的仙缘。
他原有个青梅竹马的表姐倪芳贤，因为战乱离散，以传承香火为重，另娶了名门闺秀孙洵为妻，后来携妻入山修道。
后来再遇到倪芳贤，三人同居，倪芳贤旁门心性，终究意气难平，离家出走，拜在另一位散仙门下。
三人当中，孙洵生过孩子，本身根骨资质较差，只是为人心地慈善，过去世积修了许多善功，被人同道称作五福仙子。
孙洵要做地仙，长生不老，永享仙福，那是轻松愉快，可要修证天仙位业，飞升灵空，却是极难。
倪芳贤心性中有一股嫉恨，让她落在旁门之中，始终无法炼化，拜的师父也是旁门散仙，修行越高，法力越强，越是刚强坚固。
同样，她要在人间逍遥快活，自是不难，可要修得汞性圆明，证得纯阳，也是万分不易，道路比孙洵更加坎坷，还有许多魔劫。
李静虚本人也非纯阳之体，按照玄门正宗规矩，本该再转一世，以童身入道。
他不愿意受转劫之苦，又因为爱妻功力较差，所炼元婴始终差着火候，需要他从旁相助。
他就把本身法体留在雄狮岭长春崖无忧洞中，陪着妻子孙洵修炼，自己把元婴遁出来，在人间积修善功。
期待道上有功而人间有行，前者为内功，后者为外功，内外圆满，照样可以证得天仙位业。
过去他总以元婴飞出来，后来要修炼化身，就四处搜集五行精气。
当年，他需要金行精气，在九华山快活村陆敏家后院发现金气地脉，就降临陆家，在人家后院住了数月，采炼精气。
陆敏本就四处寻仙访道，长跪恳求拜师。
李静虚不肯收他，只因着这点缘法，传授了他一点玄机，教他练成一身道法和一套剑术。

陆敏的功法是跟李静虚学的，但李静虚不承认他是自己的徒弟，因此算作未入门不记名弟子。
李静虚虽然没收他入门，但推算到他的外孙石生将是未来的峨眉七矮之一，根骨甚厚，天仙之姿，前世跟自己也有些缘法。
他便用采炼到的金气凝练成一口太白分光剑，又从乾坤袋中翻出过去收藏的鲛绡炼成离垢钟，再把一面前人仙府中无意中得到的两界牌重新炼过，一并赐予。
按照李静虚当年的推算，陆蓉波今年误嗅合欢莲，怀有身孕，陆敏拔剑要杀女儿。
他事前留下的神符会把太白分光剑收走，并把陆蓉波封在石壁之中，再写明前因后果。
最后的结局是，陆敏去北海兵解转世，陆蓉波在山中怀孕二十一年，生下一个孩子，因是感灵石精气受孕，所以起名叫石生。
娘两个一起生活了十五年，陆蓉波功行圆满，留下遗蜕，以元婴飞升仙界。
飞到半路，赶上紫云宫三凤路过，用魔砂把她的飞升灵光打破，强逼下来，带回宫中服役。
这是李静虚事前算出来的天数，本来应该按照这套定“数”
运行下去，谁知道出现了管明晦这个“变数”
，改变了陆敏父女和杨鲤师徒的命运。
content_en:
: Guan Minghui thought that Li Jingxu had great supernatural powers and that if he killed Lu Min, he would come to visit him soon, and he was determined to die.
However, at this time, Li Jingxu was still condensing the incarnation of the five innate elements.
Li Jingxu, the master of bliss, entered Taoism a little later than the master Changmei.
Around the Eastern Jin Dynasty, Changmei Zhenren was dragged down by his junior brother Deng Yin and reincarnated.
The twelve disciples under him followed the soldiers and waited for their mentor to come to save him again.
Li Jingxu obtained the immortal fate before Master Changmei entered Taoism for the second time.
He had a childhood sweetheart, his cousin Ni Fangxian, who was separated due to the war. He focused on passing on the incense and married Sun Xun, a famous lady. Later, he took his wife to the mountains to practice Taoism.
Later, I met Ni Fangxian again, and the three of them lived together. Ni Fangxian had a different character, and finally became frustrated and ran away from home to worship another Sanxian.
Among the three, Sun Xun had given birth to a child, and he was not very qualified. He was just a philanthropic person and had accumulated many good deeds in his past life. He was called the Fairy of the Five Blessings by his peers.
Sun Xun wanted to be an earthly immortal, live forever, and enjoy immortal blessings forever. It would be easy and pleasant, but it would be extremely difficult to cultivate the status of a heavenly immortal and ascend to the spiritual sky.
There is a jealousy in Ni Fangxian's heart, which makes her fall into the side sect and never be able to refine it. The master she worships is also a side sect's loose immortal. The higher her practice, the stronger her magic power and the stronger she becomes.
Similarly, it is not difficult for her to live happily in the human world, but it is also extremely difficult to cultivate the mercury nature and realize pure Yang. The road is more bumpy than Sun Xun, and there are many demonic tribulations.
Li Jingxu himself is not a pure Yang body. According to the authentic rules of Xuanmen, he should have been reincarnated in another life and entered Taoism as a child.
He didn't want to suffer the suffering of reincarnation, and because his beloved wife's skills were poor, the Nascent Soul he refined was always not in good condition, and he needed his help.
He left his Dharma body in Wuyou Cave in Changchunya, Xiongshi Ridge, and practiced with his wife Sun Xun. He escaped the Nascent Soul himself and accumulated good deeds in the human world.
It is expected that if there is merit on the Tao and there is conduct in the human world, the former is internal merit and the latter is external merit. If both internal and external are perfect, one can still achieve the status of a heavenly being.
In the past, he always flew out as a Nascent Soul. Later, when he wanted to practice his incarnation, he went around to collect the essence of the five elements.
Back then, he needed gold energy and discovered gold energy veins in the backyard of Lu Min's house in Happy Village, Jiuhua Mountain. He came to the Lu family's backyard and lived in their backyard for several months to collect the energy.
Lu Min had been searching for immortals everywhere, and he knelt down and begged to become his disciple.
Li Jingxu refused to accept him, but because of this fate, he taught him some secrets and taught him a set of Taoism and swordsmanship.
Lu Min learned the skills from Li Jingxu, but Li Jingxu did not recognize him as his disciple, so he was considered an unnamed disciple.
Although Li Jingxu did not allow him to enter, he calculated that his grandson Shisheng would be one of the seven dwarves of Emei in the future. He had a strong foundation, the appearance of an immortal, and had some connection with him in his previous life.
He used the collected gold energy to condense it into a Taibai Light-Splitting Sword, and took out the shark bramble that he had collected in the past from the Qiankun Bag to refine it into a Li Gu Bell. He then refining the Two Worlds Card that he accidentally obtained from the Immortal Mansion in front of him, and gave it to him as well.
According to Li Jingxu's calculations, Lu Rongbo accidentally sniffed the Albizia Julibrissin this year and became pregnant. Lu Min drew his sword to kill his daughter.
The talisman he left behind beforehand will take away the Taibai Light Sword, seal Lu Rongbo in the stone wall, and then write down the cause and effect.
The final outcome is that Lu Min went to Beihai to be reincarnated, and Lu Rongbo was pregnant in the mountains for twenty-one years and gave birth to a child. Because he was conceived with the spirit of the spiritual stone, he named him Shi Sheng.
The two of them lived together for fifteen years. Lu Rongbo completed his meritorious deeds, left behind a legacy, and ascended to the immortal world as a Nascent Soul.
Flying halfway, he caught up with the three phoenixes of Ziyun Palace passing by. He used magic sand to break her ascension aura, forced her down, and took her back to the palace to serve.
This is the number of days that Li Jingxu calculated in advance. The "number" should have been determined according to this set of rules.
If the operation continues, who knows that the "variable" Guan Minghui will appear?
, changed the fate of Lu Min, his daughter, and Yang Li's master and apprentice.
